remarks: Welcome to this impeccably maintained four-bedroom, two-bath home in the beautiful city of Brea, one of North Orange County’s most desirable communities. From the moment you enter the inviting foyer, an open-concept floor plan welcomes you into a beautiful formal living room, where impressive cathedral-style ceilings and a gorgeous rock fireplace create an impressive yet inviting setting. The living space flows into a generous dining room and adjoining kitchen, creating a natural connection for everyday living and entertaining.
